title: Concerted practices prohibition and other Harper CCA reforms
summary: The Competition Policy Review Act replaced price-signalling provisions with a general prohibition on concerted practices that substantially lessen competition (s 45(1)(c)) and made other cartel, exclusive dealing and authorisation changes.
